_readme: Edit dates and wording here. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and times HH:MM (SAST). After saving, open check.html on the site to confirm the file is valid. README.md explains every field.

term.name: H1 2026–27
term.source: Master Delivery Calendar v1.0 and Term Plan v1.1

members.sectorLine: Banking, insurance, asset management and financial platforms
members.focusLine: Lead the Financials theme and keep every analyst’s research credible.

safeguard.title: Independent review
safeguard.body: Your own thesis or Level 2 report needs a reviewer appointed by the Members. You may not approve your own work.

members.sectorLine: JSE-listed companies in ICB Consumer Services (402010)
members.coverage: Adjacent consumer sectors need an IC-approved boundary.
members.focusLine: Run meetings, learning, capacity and reporting while every Member keeps equal standing.

safeguard.title: Procedural chair
safeguard.body: You chair, but you do not vote first on ordinary investment decisions and you may not override research, portfolio or publication controls.

members.coverage: Keep the watchlist narrow rather than covering every sub-sector.
members.focusLine: Run the simulated portfolio’s controls and keep every position within Schedule A.

safeguard.title: Independent compliance check
safeguard.body: When you pitch, a Member appointed by the IC checks your proposal’s eligibility and compliance.

members.sectorLine: Diversified miners, precious metals, PGMs and industrial metals
members.coverage: Coal is excluded unless Members approve it.
members.focusLine: Build the records, brand standards and publication controls the next role-holder inherits.

safeguard.title: Format, not conclusions
safeguard.body: You own format, brand and publication review, not research conclusions.

society.title: Academic Priority ends
society.detail: Society-wide protection ends. Individual November exam exemptions may continue.

society.title: Active Society work resumes
society.detail: Work resumes for every Member not under a November exam exemption. Until 30 November, no new full thesis, Level 2 report or major event is imposed unless you volunteer and reviewers confirm capacity.

detailBy.pres: You update the capacity map and administer November exam exemptions. Until 30 November, no new full thesis, Level 2 report or major event is imposed unless a Member volunteers.

society.title: LinkedIn founding announcement
society.detail: In your first active week, confirm the LinkedIn page is live and publish the founding announcement, or record it if already done.

society.title: November exam notice due
society.detail: Writing a November exam? By 17:00, notify the Society through the official WhatsApp, Teams or email channel and state your final-exam date. You are excused until the day after it.

detailBy.pres: Members writing November exams notify the Society by 17:00 through the official channel, with their final-exam dates. Record each one on the capacity map.

society.title: Outlines and capacity map
society.detail: Research Manual outline and capacity map completed, Portfolio Framework current-state review completed and Publication Manual outline begun.

detailBy.pres: Complete the capacity map, so dependent work follows each Member’s resumption.
detailBy.hor: Complete the outline of the Investment Research and Thesis Standards Manual.
detailBy.pm: Complete the current-state review of the Portfolio Framework, with its gap record.
detailBy.coo: Begin the outline of the Brand, Document and Publication Standards Manual.

society.title: First drafts and Traffic-Light Review 1
society.detail: First operating-pack drafts are filed. Traffic-Light Review 1 rates every Foundation item green, amber or red.

detailBy.pres: You lead Traffic-Light Review 1. Every amber or red Foundation item gets an owner, support and a revised date.
detailBy.hor: File your first operating-pack drafts for Traffic-Light Review 1.
detailBy.pm: File your first operating-pack drafts for Traffic-Light Review 1.
detailBy.coo: File your first operating-pack drafts for Traffic-Light Review 1.

society.title: Cross-role consistency review
society.detail: Research, portfolio, records, publication, access and approval dependencies tested on paper.

society.title: Portfolio Framework validated
society.detail: Gap assessment and controlled version, circulated in the controlled IC pre-read with the templates, tracker and open corrections.

society.title: Research Standards Manual draft
society.detail: Controlled draft of the Investment Research and Thesis Standards Manual with its correction register, circulated in the controlled IC pre-read.

society.title: Brand and Publication Manual draft
society.detail: Controlled draft of the Brand, Document and Publication Standards Manual with its correction register, circulated in the controlled IC pre-read.

society.title: Formal IC 1
society.detail: Operating-pack review, provisional workflow-test decisions, correction owners and deadlines. Proceeds only with quorum.

detailBy.pres: You chair: operating-pack review, provisional workflow-test decisions, correction owners and deadlines. Circulate the agenda by Friday 17:00; without quorum, move to the nearest Sunday with quorum.
detailBy.coo: Operating-pack review, provisional workflow-test decisions, correction owners and deadlines. You file the minutes and resolutions by Tuesday 17:00.
detailBy.pm: Operating-pack review, provisional workflow-test decisions, correction owners and deadlines. You present the portfolio and mandate update.
detailBy.hor: Operating-pack review, provisional workflow-test decisions, correction owners and deadlines. You lead the research discussion.

society.title: End-to-end workflow test
society.detail: One sample idea run through registration, pre-clearance, research review, version control, circulation, decision recording and publication controls, with a defect register.

society.title: Learning Session 1: How financial services companies make money
society.detail: One-page brief, facilitated discussion and an application exercise: compare a bank, an insurer and an asset manager, and how each earns revenue and absorbs risk.

society.title: Foundation phase closes
society.detail: Operating manuals, templates, tracker, folders and access controls approved and live.

detailBy.hor: Your Research Standards Manual is approved and live.
detailBy.pm: Your Portfolio Framework, tracker and registers are approved and live.
detailBy.coo: Your Brand Manual, templates and asset pack are approved and live.

society.title: Year-end recess
society.detail: Reduced activity: urgent governance, record preservation and portfolio monitoring only. No major original work.

detailBy.pres: Reduced activity. Only urgent governance, record preservation and portfolio monitoring; you file any urgent resolution.
detailBy.pm: Reduced activity. You keep lightweight portfolio monitoring; urgent mandate matters use a written resolution.
detailBy.coo: Reduced activity. Only urgent governance and record preservation; you keep any urgent resolution on record.

society.title: Theme primer in, sector briefs to review

detailBy.coo: Sector readiness, theme primer, watchlist quality, portfolio capacity and corrective actions. You file the minutes and resolutions by Tuesday 17:00.

society.detail: Pre-clear every other analyst’s candidate within two working days of complete information. A Member appointed by the IC verifies your own.

society.title: Learning Session 2: Valuing financial companies
society.detail: Compare two JSE-listed financial companies and defend the valuation premium or discount.

analyst.detail: Submit your {sector} initiation brief (value chain, listed universe, profit drivers, risks, legislation and indicators) and a focused watchlist of five to ten companies for quality review.

analyst.detail: Your brief and watchlist are accepted. Register your preferred candidate with a primary source pack and get Portfolio Manager pre-clearance.

detailBy.pm: Your brief and watchlist are accepted. Register your preferred candidate with a primary source pack. A Member appointed by the IC verifies its eligibility, not you.

analyst.detail: Submit your complete thesis and model to the Head of Research, five working days before Pitch IC A.

ic1.detail: Operating-pack review. Every full IC carries a five-to-ten-minute Concept of the Meeting: present yours at IC 1, 2, 3 or 6.

ic2.detail: Sector readiness: your brief, watchlist quality and portfolio capacity.

pica.label: You pitch
pica.detail: Present your thesis for discussion and a simulated investment decision. Research approval does not compel an investment.

picb.label: You pitch
picb.detail: Present your thesis for discussion and a simulated investment decision. Research approval does not compel an investment.

close.detail: Scorecard, H2 recommendations and the closing resolution. Your handover note and peer evaluation are filed by today.

analystScorecard.name: Concept of the Meeting
analystScorecard.when: 5 to 10 minutes at a full IC

shared.title: Academic Priority
shared.body: 1 September to 31 October: no mandatory meeting, duty or major deliverable. Urgent matters use a written resolution.

shared.title: November exams
shared.body: Notify the Society by 17:00 on 2 November through WhatsApp, Teams or email, with your final-exam date. You are excused until the day after it.

shared.title: Deadlines
shared.body: Every deadline closes at {time} SAST on its due date, unless a different time is shown.

shared.title: Meetings and quorum
shared.body: Sundays 17:00 to 18:30 on Teams. Agenda by Friday 17:00 and minutes by Tuesday 17:00. Pre-reads go out by Saturday 17:00 before a Pitch IC, and on 4 December for IC 1. Three of the four Members make quorum; without it, the meeting moves to the next Sunday with quorum.

shared.title: What the colours mean
shared.body: Your deadlines stay navy until they are close. Soft orange means due within a week; solid orange, within two days. Green means the Society has accepted the work. A grey tick means you marked it submitted, which only you see.

analyst.title: Review times
analyst.body: Pre-clearance within two working days of complete information. Research comments within three. Revised work reviewed within two where possible.

analyst.title: Quality gate
analyst.body: Work is complete when it is accepted, not when it is submitted.

analyst.title: One pitch at a time
analyst.body: One active primary pitch per analyst in review, unless the Head of Research and Portfolio Manager confirm capacity and Members approve.

analyst.title: Your work stays yours
analyst.body: Review does not transfer authorship: you keep responsibility for your sources, reasoning and conclusions. No analyst holds a personal capital allocation.

checklists.title: Sector brief and watchlist
items: Watchlist of five to ten companies
Ownership, screening notes and monitoring fields for each company

checklists.title: Thesis candidate
checklists.source: Term Plan v1.1, sections 11.1 and 17.3, and Constitution Schedule A4
items: Idea registered: company, sector, rationale, data availability and potential overlap
Within the permitted universe: JSE-listed or global listed shares or ETFs
Complete information sent for pre-clearance (two working days)

checklists.title: Documented thesis
checklists.source: Constitution Schedule A9 and A10, and Term Plan v1.1, section 11.2
items: Proposed position size, within the 20% limit
Recommendation: initiate, avoid, hold, increase, reduce or exit
Facts, assumptions, estimates, opinions and conclusions kept distinct

checklists.title: Final pre-read
items: Every review comment addressed, or reasoned written disagreement given
Approved template, version and classification confirmed with the COO
Final controlled pre-read circulated by Saturday 17:00

checklists.title: Secondary contribution and development
items: One company update, valuation comparison, catalyst note, monitoring note or equivalent
